microsoft.description: Microsoft (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd began operations in Malaysia in July 1992. It supports businesses and communities with software, cloud services and technology solutions.
microsoft.parent_description: Microsoft Corporation is an American multinational technology company whose products and services include software, cloud computing, consumer electronics and personal computers.
microsoft.source_note: Incorporation date follows Experian. EMIS lists 7 August 1992 instead; a current SSM extract has not been checked. The Menara Shell address is listed by EMIS. Office information may change. Parent-company background is separate from the Malaysian entity.

external_interviews.title: Senior Software Engineer interview
external_interviews.application: In this demo scenario, the candidate applies through an employee referral and completes a four-week interview process.
external_interviews.interview: This demo scenario includes five rounds covering coding, data structures and algorithms, low-level design and high-level design, with a focus on clear reasoning and trade-offs.
external_interviews.source_note: Demo scenario adapted from a supplied interview screenshot for interface demonstration. It is not a verified Microsoft Malaysia experience and does not contribute to ratings.

nexusdigital.description: NexusDigital is a results-driven digital marketing agency based in Kuala Lumpur, serving Malaysian SMEs since 2016. It brings SEO specialists, Google Ads experts, web developers, social media strategists and video producers together to deliver an integrated digital presence focused on measurable growth.
highlights: Results-driven
Strategies tied to measurable KPIs and business outcomes.
Client-first
A focus on clients’ long-term growth and success.
Local experts
Knowledge of the Malaysian market and consumer behaviour.
Transparent
Clear monthly reporting on results and investment.
nexusdigital.source_note: Profile overview supplied for this company. These describe the agency’s services and approach, not employee benefits.
